META_DESCRIPTION: Track every streaming service, SaaS tool, and recurring subscription. FincWin's Subscriptions envelope exposes the true cost of convenience.
HERO_H1:
You're paying for things
you forgot you subscribed to.
HERO_SUB: Netflix, Spotify, Notion, Adobe, that meditation app you used twice — subscriptions are the modern money leak. FincWin's Subscriptions envelope makes every one of them visible in one place.
PAIN_H2:
The average person pays for
subscriptions they don't use.
PAIN_ITEM_1_H3: The free trial that became a paid plan
PAIN_ITEM_1_P: You signed up for a 14-day free trial of that project management tool. You forgot to cancel. It's been 8 months. You've paid $192 for software you opened twice.
PAIN_ITEM_2_H3: Annual subscriptions hit like a truck
PAIN_ITEM_2_P: $9.99/month sounds fine. $119.88 in one charge in January does not. Without a system, annual renewals always feel like a surprise — even when they shouldn't be.
PAIN_ITEM_3_H3: Seven streaming services, two you actually watch
PAIN_ITEM_3_P: You have Netflix, HBO, Disney+, Apple TV+, Paramount+, Peacock, and Hulu. You're paying $78/month. You watch two of them. The rest are just expensive background noise.
FEATURES_H2:
The Subscriptions envelope:
your complete sub audit.
CARD_1_P: Log each subscription with its name, amount, and frequency — monthly or annual. See the full list at a glance. Spot the ones you forgot about immediately.
CARD_2_P: FincWin tracks yearly subscriptions and shows them in your upcoming bills view. No more January shocks from annual renewals you forgot were coming.
CARD_3_P: Set a Subscriptions cap. When you're near it, you'll know exactly which service to cut. Make the decision from data, not guilt.
